einzeiler: Dublin rapper KhakiKid talks about his roots, viral hits, and full band setup.
kurzfassung: Dublin rapper KhakiKid joins World Cafe for a live performance and conversation at Windmill Lane Studios. He discusses growing up in a bustling household, dropping out of college to pursue music, and recording his latest EP, Girl Bites Dog. Backed by a full band, he performs live tracks including Soul, Schlumped Up, Date Night, and Shoes Up.
stichpunkte: KhakiKid performs live with a full band at Dublin's Windmill Lane Studios for World Cafe.
He explains how meeting Fat Boy during the pandemic introduced him to live instrumentation in rap.
Growing up in a crowded council house with six siblings meant sharing a single bathroom and bedroom space.
He famously hid his college drop-out from his mother for two months to pursue music.
Early recording sessions took place under his bed while younger brothers played video games loudly.
His viral 2025 track Date Night gained massive traction following the release of a joyful music video.
The song Underbite explores his Libyan heritage and his father's background as a refugee.
The episode features live performances of Soul, Schlumped Up, Date Night, and Shoes Up from the EP Girl Bites Dog.

clips.text: The artist describes the chaotic living conditions of his childhood home shared by seven family members with only a single bathroom.

clips.hook: Two years of secret raps sent to a crush
clips.text: As a twelve-year-old wanting a digital notepad, he texted years of rap lyrics to a deactivated Facebook account of a girl he liked.

clips.hook: Lying about college to pursue rap
clips.text: He kept up the pretense of attending university for two months before admitting to his mother that he dropped out for a rap career.

clips.hook: The challenge of being a crybaby in Ireland
clips.text: He explains that while self-deprecation comes easily in Irish culture, showing genuine vulnerability and emotional pain is much harder.
The host marvels at his stage presence while he humorously exaggerates his height.

beschreibung:
The rising artist landed a viral hit in 2025 with "Date Night." He's following it up with a new EP, Girl Bites Dog.
